描述_EN: circular panel in 9 shaped sections; embroidered silk in various colours with the image of an old man in a red robe, with a wooden staff, with a small spotted yellow deer with a branch sprig in its mouth, on a silver silk ground. each section bound with satin. other panels which form an overall quatrefoil shape, have floral motifs, with large flowers, leaves and stems, with the top lobe panel having a large butterfly all in various colours. backed with green silk.
描述_ZN: circular panel in 9 shaped sections; embroidered silk in various colours with the image of an old man in a red robe, with a wooden staff, with a small spotted yellow deer with a branch sprig in its mouth, on a silver silk ground. 每个部分都用缎子装订。 其他面板形成一个整体的四叶形，有花卉图案，有大花、叶子和茎，顶叶面板有一只大蝴蝶，都是各种颜色的。 以绿色丝绸为底。
